observations: White multi-function printer with a paper tray at the front.
HP logo is visible on the top left of the front panel.
A colorful promotional sticker is wrapped around the front and top of the unit.
The unit is wrapped in clear plastic film.
The top lid of the printer is open.
The unit is sitting on top of another white box or container.

claims.claim: Get the fastest in-class two-sided printing speed
Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The printer may not power on or may have a faulty print head.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and successfully printing a test page.

risks.risk: The internal drum and toner may be expired or degraded.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Last Used Date' sticker on the toner cartridge.

risks.risk: The printer may have a mechanical fault or high error rates.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer completing a full print cycle without errors.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the 'Last Used Date' sticker on the toner cartridge.
Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the printer with the lid closed to check for dust or damage.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
